name: keka
description: Keka-equivalent HR & Payroll platform — multi-tenant HRMS with Indian statutory payroll

scripts.build: npm run generate --workspace=@keka/db && npm run build --workspace=@keka/web
scripts.test: tsx --test packages/payroll/test/*.test.ts packages/time/test/*.test.ts packages/rbac/test/*.test.ts packages/documents/test/*.test.ts packages/services/test/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: for p in packages/services packages/rbac packages/time packages/documents apps/web; do echo "### $p"; tsc --noEmit -p $p || exit 1; done
scripts.test:smoke: for s in smoke-seams smoke-crud smoke-employee smoke-payroll-config smoke-time smoke-time-ui smoke-lifecycle smoke-loans smoke-auth smoke-filings smoke-performance smoke-hiring smoke-expenses smoke-projects smoke-accounting smoke-self-service smoke-engage-learn smoke-isolation; do echo "\n### $s"; tsx scripts/$s.ts || exit 1; done
